$comment: Security headers Caddy sends for docs.jellyrock.app and dev.jellyrock.app (both blocks import the same snippets; their config lives in jellyrock/infra). The browser tests serve each build with these. Strict-Transport-Security is left out: it only applies over HTTPS.
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'
Permissions-Policy: accelerometer=(), autoplay=(), camera=(), display-capture=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), keyboard-map=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), midi=(), payment=(), picture-in-picture=(), screen-wake-lock=(), sync-xhr=(), xr-spatial-tracking=(), interest-cohort=()
